name: Image URL Checker
description: Check the full result, reuse repeated URLs, and join a detailed image report back to the original rows.

fields.label: Image URL columns
fields.help: Select one or more columns. Every row of the query is included, not just the page on screen. Identical URL strings are checked once per run.

fields.label: Product or record ID column
fields.help: Included in remediation exports; generated row identities still protect merges.

fields.label: Allowed formats
fields.help: Comma-separated, for example JPEG, PNG, WEBP. Blank allows any supported format.

fields.label: Maximum image size, KB
fields.help: A business requirement, separate from the download safety limit. 0 disables it.

fields.label: Minimum aspect ratio (width / height)
fields.help: 1 means square. Use 0.95 to 1.05 for nearly square images. 0 disables.

fields.label: Known placeholder SHA-256 hashes
fields.help: Space-separated hashes from confirmed placeholder report rows. Exact matches fail requirements.

fields.label: Shared-image review threshold, records
fields.help: Flag identical content affecting this many records for review; shared images can be legitimate.

fields.label: Expected width column
fields.help: Optional pixel-width expectation from each input row.

fields.label: Expected height column
fields.help: Optional pixel-height expectation from each input row.

fields.label: Expected image size column (bytes)
fields.help: Optional exact byte count of the image content, after HTTP content decoding.

fields.label: Expected MIME type column
fields.help: Optional type such as image/jpeg. Compared against the detected image type.

fields.label: Minimum width, pixels
fields.help: 0 means no extra minimum. These limits apply in addition to mapped expectations.

fields.label: Concurrent URL checks
fields.help: Lower values use less RAM and are gentler on websites. Requests to the same host are spaced apart.

fields.label: Maximum download per URL, MB
fields.help: Both transferred and decompressed content are bounded. Larger images are reported as limited, not passed.

fields.label: Maximum decoded megapixels
fields.help: Protects laptop RAM. Larger images are identified but not fully decoded.

fields.label: Maximum animation frames to decode
fields.help: A second total-pixel budget bounds animation work. Unchecked frames are reported as partial.

fields.label: Whole run limit, seconds
fields.help: 0 means until finished or cancelled. Completed URLs are saved for Resume.

fields.label: Allow private-network URLs
fields.help: Off blocks loopback, LAN, link-local and other non-public addresses at every redirect. Turn on only for image servers you intend to access on your network.

fields.label: Find visually similar images
fields.help: Compare distinct image contents locally. Similarity is a review signal and does not change pass/fail verdicts.

fields.label: Visual matching sensitivity
choices: Broad - more candidates and false matches

fields.label: Include color variants
fields.help: Include images with similar structure but different average colors.

fields.label: Maximum similarity search time, seconds
fields.help: Other bounded comparison and pair limits also apply. Incomplete searches are identified explicitly.
